label.purpose: Compact field labels and status context.

shadows.name: work-surface-lift
shadows.purpose: Separate cards from the pale app background without heavy elevation.

motion.name: handoff-step-advance
motion.purpose: Acknowledge a real case-state transition; never animate initial loading or case switching.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Confident jade action for the next handoff step.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 42px; padding: 0.7rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--route); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--route); color: #fff; font: 700 14px/1.2 var(--font-display); transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { border-color: #105e55; background: #105e55; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2b8a7b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: High-contrast field with an explicit keyboard-focus state.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" aria-label="RFID card UID" placeholder="Enter card UID" />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 42px; padding: 0.65rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid #bacdc7; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font: 400 14px var(--font-mono); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--route); outline: 2px solid #a7d6ca; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Active Navigation
components.description: Pale-jade active role in the deep-teal navigation shell.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; padding: 0 11px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--route-soft); color: var(--board-deep); font: 700 14px var(--font-display); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #a7d6ca; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Readable state label paired with a restrained tint.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; min-height: 22px; align-items: center; padding: 0.28rem 0.5rem; border: 1px solid #abd4c5; border-radius: 6px; background: #eaf6f0; color: #205a49; font: 600 11px/1 var(--font-mono); }

components.name: Work Surface
components.description: White handoff panel with fine border and quiet lift.
components.html:
Patient identification

Scan the patient RFID card.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--paper-line); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: var(--shadow-strip); font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-mono); } .ds-card p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--text-muted); }

components.name: Handoff Progress
components.description: Four text-labeled case stages with a state-aware route marker.
components.html:
1. Patient identified
  2. Hospital selected
  3. Hospital acknowledged
  4. Case closed
components.css: .ds-progress { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-progress li { position: relative; display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #526e71; font: 600 11px/1.3 var(--font-mono); text-align: center; } .ds-progress li::before { width: 16px; height: 16px; border: 2px solid #98b3ac; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; content: ''; } .ds-progress li.is-complete::before { border-color: var(--route); background: var(--route); } .ds-progress li.is-current::before { border: 5px solid var(--route); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--route-soft); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-progress * { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; } }

components.name: Quick Concern Toggle
components.description: Independently toggle multiple crew-reported concerns into an editable message draft.
components.html: <button class="ds-concern" type="button" aria-pressed="true">Breathing difficulty</button><button class="ds-concern" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Chest discomfort</button>
components.css: .ds-concern { min-height: 38px; padding: 0.55rem 0.7rem; border: 1px solid #bdcfca; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #25494d; font: 600 12px var(--font-mono); transition: border-color 140ms ease, background-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-concern:hover { border-color: #6ea99a; background: #f3faf7; } .ds-concern[aria-pressed='true'] { border-color: var(--route); background: var(--route-soft); color: #124e46; } .ds-concern:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2b8a7b; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
AYU-LINK is a calm, high-contrast workspace for the ambulance-to-hospital handoff. Its deep-teal navigation rail anchors warm-white work surfaces, while concise labels and a humanist typeface keep patient and case information easy to scan in a moving ambulance or at a hospital desk.

The interface makes the next handoff step visible without implying a diagnosis, geographic route, travel time, or clinical certainty. Motion is reserved for a real change in handoff state. The same visual language carries across the ambulance, hospital, doctor, and administrator workspaces.
keyCharacteristics: Patient identity and the next handoff action stay prominent.
Status always uses readable labels as well as color.
Quick concerns draft crew-reported messages; they do not diagnose or change the emergency category.

rules.name: The Concern-Is-Not-Diagnosis Rule
rules.body: Concern shortcuts create editable, crew-reported message drafts and never set the emergency category.

rules.name: The No-Fabricated-Route Rule
rules.body: Handoff progress describes case states only; it does not imply a map, distance, location, or ETA.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Keep all interface text in Atkinson Hyperlegible Next; use weight and size, not a second typeface, to establish hierarchy.

dos: Do put patient identity, case state, and the next action in the scan path.
Do keep color-coded states legible by text and shape.
Do keep the four operational roles and their existing access boundaries.
Do animate only genuine state changes and honor reduced-motion settings.
Do make concern drafts editable before the crew sends them.
Do let crews select multiple concern chips and toggle each one independently.
donts: Don't use a concern shortcut as a diagnosis or emergency-category update.
Don't invent a location, map, distance, ETA, or clinical claim.
Don't use red as a general accent or decorate the interface with control-room imagery.
Don't hide important controls behind hover-only behavior.
